nodes.question: Why do Yates and Evans (2016) emphasize the importance of contextualizing behaviours when exploring everyday practices?
nodes.answer: Yates and Evans (2016) stress the importance of contextualizing behaviours to consider the dynamics of related activities encompassed in the practice and the effects of related and interlocking practices and cultural meanings around it for a more comprehensive understanding.
